run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T08:57:16Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning on otel-demo/frontend-proxy traces to CPU starvation of the recommendation service injected by the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-recommendation-cpu-stress in namespace chaos-mesh. That schedule spawns a StressChaos every minute from 08:54:12Z that applies CPU stress to pod otel-demo/recommendation-5f45f75855-htttv container recommendation (event view 0bd176e2-...t0). On that pod, CPU usage rose from ~0.011 cores to ~0.09-0.10 cores, pinned at its 100m container limit, at 08:54:30Z, and CFS throttling went from ~5% to 96-100% (79999c16-...t0, 71046df5-...t0); at 09:05:00Z it was the most throttled pod in otel-demo at 0.974 versus 0.252 for the next pod (d9e3986a-...t1). Latency of frontend's ListRecommendations client span rose from a 150-235 ms p95 baseline to 6912 ms at 08:56:16Z and 15000 ms from 09:00:16Z (b7849d54-...t0), and recommendation's own span throughput fell to zero from 09:00:16Z (b7849d54-...t1). Trace 40fc89a0cadcbbb31ce5939d98b85f7e shows the path: load-generator user_get_recommendations -> frontend-proxy ingress 504 after 15.00 s with its router frontend egress span at 15.00 s and http.status_code 0 -> frontend GET /api/recommendations completing only after 15.08 s -> frontend grpc ListRecommendations taking 15.07 s (d939b30f-...t0). frontend-proxy's 5-minute ingress error rate rose from ~0.0037 per second through 08:57:16Z to 0.0259 at 08:58:16Z, peaked at 0.1481 at 09:03:16Z and read 0.0667 at 09:05:16Z, matching the alert's current value (61c78387-...t2). The read error-span slice is entirely ingress 504s at ~15 s paired with egress spans carrying http.status_code 0 (bb885bea-...t0). The affected pods are Running and ready with zero restarts; this is a latency failure, not a crash, and frontend and recommendation themselves reported zero ERROR spans in the 20 minutes examined (a6580f54-...t1). Two unrelated items were observed and rejected as causes of this alert: fraud-detection OOMKilled (exit 137) at 08:36:51Z with 3 restarts and a BackOff event at 08:37:04Z, and ad's flagd EventStream spans ending with 'stream closed due to server-side timeout' (gRPC code 4).

claims.text: frontend-proxy recorded 63.98 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans versus 22604.77 STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans on operation 'ingress' over the hour ending 09:09:41Z; operation 'router frontend egress' had 0 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans out of 22668.75.

The 5-minute error rate of frontend-proxy operation 'ingress' was ~0.0037 per second through 08:57:16Z, then 0.0259 at 08:58:16Z, 0.0407 at 08:59:16Z, 0.0963 at 09:00:16Z, 0.1481 at 09:03:16Z, and 0.0667 at 09:05:16Z (the alert's reported current value); ingress span rate fell from ~8.8 to 2.5 per second by 09:09:16Z.

In the read slice, every frontend-proxy error span is operation 'ingress' with http.status_code 504, otel.status_code ERROR and duration ~15,000,000 us, paired with a child 'router frontend egress' span of the same ~15 s duration carrying error="true" and http.status_code="0".

Trace 40fc89a0cadcbbb31ce5939d98b85f7e shows load-generator 'user_get_recommendations' 15.004 s -> load-generator GET 15.003 s http 504 -> frontend-proxy 'ingress' 15.002 s http 504 -> frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' 15.001 s http.status_code 0 -> frontend GET 15.001 s -> frontend 'GET /api/recommendations' 15.077 s http 200 -> frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations' 15.074 s.

The p95 duration of frontend's client span 'grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations' held a 150-235 ms baseline from 08:33:16Z through 08:55:16Z, then rose to 6912 ms at 08:56:16Z, 9129 ms at 08:57:16Z, 10937 ms at 08:58:16Z, 13729 ms at 08:59:16Z and 15000 ms from 09:00:16Z through 09:08:16Z.
recommendation's own p95 was 43-115 ms through 08:55:16Z, then 193 ms at 08:56:16Z, 460 ms at 08:57:16Z, 710 ms at 08:58:16Z, 917 ms at 08:59:16Z and NaN from 09:00:16Z onward.

recommendation span counts ('/oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations', '/oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts', 'get_product_list') fell from ~245 per 5-minute window to 142.2 at 08:57:16Z, 86.7 at 08:58:16Z, 27.8 at 08:59:16Z and 0 from 09:00:16Z.

Container CPU usage of pod recommendation-5f45f75855-htttv container 'recommendation' was ~0.010-0.014 cores until 08:54:00Z, then 0.0297 at 08:54:30Z and a sustained 0.078-0.100 cores from 08:55:00Z onward; the deployment declares a CPU limit of 100m and request of 30m for that container.

CFS throttling ratio for pod recommendation-5f45f75855-htttv was ~4-6% until 08:54:30Z, then 18.5% at 08:54:30Z, 48.4% at 08:55:00Z, 73.8% at 08:55:30Z and 95.6-100% from 08:56:00Z through 09:06:30Z; at 09:05:00Z it was the highest in otel-demo at 0.974 versus 0.252 for the next pod, cart-755465879b-hjqf6.

Chaos Mesh events in namespace chaos-mesh show Schedule 'otel-demo-recommendation-cpu-stress' spawning an experiment every minute from 08:54:12Z to 09:02:12Z (Reason Spawned), and each child (e.g. -lwlmp 08:57:12Z, -h7zr7 08:58:12Z, -6p484 08:59:12Z) logging 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/recommendation-5f45f75855-htttv/recommendation' then TimeUp/Recovered about 55 seconds later.

Pod recommendation-5f45f75855-htttv is Running and ready, owned by ReplicaSet recommendation-5f45f75855, created 08:15:53Z with 0 restarts, and its container logs show continuous 'Receive ListRecommendations ...' lines through 09:02:20Z.

Over the 20 minutes ending 09:09:41Z, ERROR-status span increases were frontend-proxy 60.28, ad 2.04 and fraud-detection 1.04, while frontend, cart, payment and recommendation each returned 0 error spans, including every listed frontend and recommendation operation series.

The pre-deviation frontend-proxy errors from 08:42:27Z to 08:50:38Z are a different class: ingress http.status_code 503 with durations of 33 ms to 713 ms on load-generator paths user_browse_product and user_view_cart, and the sampled 503 trace d6b3b5f91c1494ffbb084abad52a769f contains no frontend span.
Neither frontend nor recommendation produced any ERROR-status span in the 20-minute window, so this incident does not appear as application exceptions in those services.
The recommendation pod did not crash or restart: it is Running and ready with restartCount 0 and its container kept logging incoming ListRecommendations requests through 09:02:20Z.

The fraud-detection pod OOMKilled at 08:36:51Z (last termination exit code 137, restartCount 3) with a BackOff event at 08:37:04Z is not this alert's cause: it predates the error-rate deviation at 08:56-08:58Z, the pod is now running and ready, and the observed 504 path runs through recommendation latency rather than checkout or fraud code.

The ad service's error spans are not on this failure path: the sampled ones are 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' spans of 600,002,478 us and 599,999,896 us with rpc.grpc.status_code 4 and description 'stream closed due to server-side timeout', a long-lived stream deadline rather than an ingress request error.

The 100m CPU limit on the recommendation container amplifies the injected stress: usage pins at that ceiling and produces 96-100% CFS throttling, starving the gRPC handler until frontend's ListRecommendations call exceeds the 15 s timeout frontend-proxy enforces; the chaos events name the exact target pod and container that showed the CPU jump and throttling.

If the recurring CPU stress is not an intentional experiment, pause or remove the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-recommendation-cpu-stress in namespace chaos-mesh, and review whether the recommendation container's 100m CPU limit leaves adequate headroom.

gaps: The Chaos Mesh Schedule and StressChaos objects could not be read (no Chaos Mesh CRD kind is offered by the available Kubernetes tools; the attempt returned INVALID_PARAMS), so the stress spec — selector mode, workers, load and duration — is known only from event messages.

The RequestErrorRate rule definition could not be retrieved: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned status no_data with no rules, so the rule's expression and evaluation window are unknown.

The kept frontend-proxy error-span view was truncated and incomplete: 340 rows existed and only a 45-row slice at offset 0 was read, all of them 504/15 s; the full distribution of status codes and upstream paths across the remaining error spans is unknown.

The chaos-mesh event listing is a filtered selection of 120 of 198 processed event items, and event timestamps stop at 09:02:20Z, so whether the Schedule keeps spawning experiments after that time is unknown even though recommendation throttling was still ~100% at 09:06:30Z.

No recommendation server span appears in trace 40fc89a0cadcbbb31ce5939d98b85f7e, so the 15 s figure rests on frontend's client span and recommendation's aggregate histogram rather than a parent-child edge observed from the recommendation side.

Error-status series were returned only for ad, cart, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, payment and recommendation; error status for checkout, shipping, currency, email, image-provider, quote, kafka and product-catalog is unknown rather than zero.

The 503-class background errors at 08:42-08:50Z could not be attributed: the sampled 503 trace contains no frontend span, and the frontend log query for 08:50-09:06Z with an error/timeout filter returned status no_data with 0 lines read, so frontend application-log evidence for the incident window is absent rather than clean.
The fraud-detection log query for 08:25-08:45Z with an error/OOM filter returned status no_data with no matching lines, so the OOMKilled container's own last words could not be read.

The pre-incident trace search for frontend-proxy errors was incomplete ('backend returned as many traces as requested; more may exist'), so the 503 background baseline is not exhaustively characterized.
next_steps: Have the cluster owner inspect the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-recommendation-cpu-stress and its StressChaos children to confirm intent and the stress parameters.
Review the recommendation deployment's CPU request/limit (30m/100m) against expected load and decide whether to raise the limit or stop the recurring CPU stress.
Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition from the Prometheus configuration to confirm the window and threshold that produced the 0.0667 reading at 09:05:16Z.
Separately review the fraud-detection OOMKilled restart at 08:36:51Z and the intermittent sub-second 503 responses on browse/cart paths, which are unrelated to this alert's 504 escalation.
